messages:
jia: Quick smoke on halcyon-v1 int8 bring-up. Observed weird detok/spacing for vertical KR samples and some RTL punctuation shifts when using q8_fused kernel. Small repro attached below. Anyone else seeing locale-specific regressions?

samir: same here on our WMT-ish short-line tests — BLEU drops ~2.5-3.0 on samples with ruby/vertical breaks. Looks like token boundary shift rather than hallucination.

kevin: can you paste the tokenizer config and which quant pipeline you used (q8_fused / q8_split / int8-static)?

jia: sure — quick config:```
model: halcyon-v1
quant: int8
kernel: q8_fused
tokenizer: sentencepiece_v1
continuous_batching: true
postprocess: detok_v3
```
repro input (simplified):```
日本語：漢字
◌ー
서울
후
```
expected detok: `서울후`  actual detok: `서 울후` (space inserted mid-syllable)

reena: I ran the same eval with prefix caching disabled and still saw it — so probably postprocess/detok path interacting with quant kernel. Logs show token boundaries: `▁서` `울` splitting weirdly after quant. Past bug we had with bertha-v2 int8 was similar but only on continuous_batching=true.

luisa: hypothesis: embedding table alignment + byte-pair merges near ZWJ/ZWNJ boundaries cause index offsets after quantized kernel rounding. We observed ZWJ merges flipping on earlier int8 bringups.

ciara-bot: eval-runner: halcyon-v1/int8 smoke finished. Summary: samples=1200, regressions=34, top localities: CJK vertical folding (KR), JP ruby/furigana spacing, AR punctuation reorder. Full diff at https://ci.redwood/infer/halcyon_v1/int8/smoke/2876549999

samir: assigning to eng-ml triage. Can we bisect kernel implementations q8_fused vs q8_split and also try kernel with postprocess in FP32?

kevin: will run kernel-diff on staging GPU pool (a100-int8). cc @reena for logs. If it's alignment, the q8_split should be unaffected.

jia: minimal repro script (python):```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
 t=Tokenizer.from_file('sp.model')
 s='서울
후'
 toks=t.encode(s).tokens
 print(toks)
# run model inference with q8_fused vs q8_split and compare detok outputs
```

luisa: :eyes: adding a couple of saved failing samples (KR vertical + JP ruby) to the shared drive.

kevin: initial run shows q8_split matches fp32 output; q8_fused has boundary shift when batch_size>1 and continuous_batching enabled. Repro indicates postprocess_detok assumes contiguous token IDs that are sometimes shifted by a stride bug in fused kernel.

jia: thanks — I'll open INF-2347 with logs + failing samples and add per-locale unit tests for KR verticals, JP ruby, and AR bidi punctuation. If someone has more edge cases (ZWJ-heavy or ruby+newline combos) drop them here.

reena: adding a note — turn off continuous_batching on dedicated for now as a mitigation until kernel patch lands. :thumbsup:

eval-runner: CI job queued: halcyon-v1/int8-kernel-bisect (will run q8_fused vs q8_split full smoke). ETA ~40m.
